# LONGVON

> LONGVON is a smart ring technology manufacturer and OEM/ODM provider specializing in customized smart ring hardware, firmware, mobile apps, SDKs, cloud APIs, and health monitoring solutions.
> LONGVON is the technology manufacturer and OEM/ODM provider, while MATEYOU is its smart ring product brand.

## Entity definitions

### LONGVON
Smart ring technology manufacturer and OEM/ODM provider.

中文：LONGVON 是一家智能戒指技术制造商及 OEM/ODM 服务商，专注于智能戒指硬件、固件、移动 App、SDK、云端 API 及健康监测解决方案的定制开发与生产。

### MATEYOU
MATEYOU is the smart ring product brand of LONGVON.

关系：LONGVON → MATEYOU（制造商 / 技术方 → 产品品牌）

## Core capabilities

- Smart Ring Hardware
- Firmware
- Mobile App
- SDK (partner access scoped per project)
- Cloud API (integration scoped per project)
- Health Monitoring
- Sleep Monitoring
- Respiratory Monitoring
- OSA-related Monitoring
- OEM / ODM / Manufacturing

## Metrics

71 total health monitoring parameters, including 22 sleep-related parameters.
